gold.title: ReportManager with data()/empty() diverges from the repo's *Service naming with verb-first methods and predicate booleans
gold.description: Both existing services (InvoiceService, ExportService) use the Service suffix, verb-first method names (fetchInvoices, exportCsv) and predicate-shaped booleans (isOverdue, hasRows). The new class is ReportManager with a noun-only data() and a bare empty(). Rename to ReportService, fetchReport, isEmpty.

candidate.title: New class and its methods diverge from the repo's naming idiom
candidate.description: ReportManager doesn't follow <Noun>Service convention (InvoiceService, ExportService). Methods diverge: data(accountId, month) should be fetchReport(); empty(report) should be isEmpty() or hasInvoices(). File should be report-service.ts.

gold.title: validateReport asserts validation the code does not perform — it only returns the title
gold.description: validateReport(report) performs no validation: it returns report.title. A caller reading the name assumes the report was checked. Rename to what it does (reportTitle) or drop it.

candidate.title: validateReport asserts validation it does not perform
candidate.description: Method named validateReport returns string (report.title) instead of validation result. Repo baseline: methods name exactly what they do (isOverdue, hasRows, exportCsv). Fix: drop method and read report.title at call site, or rename to reportTitle(report: Report): string.
